objective: Can an anonymous categorical solver learn when semantic cell geometry, across-field co-occurrence, or their probability fusion adds to its existing frozen winner?
entry: Opt-in encoder-portfolio review after the ordinary 64-fit autonomous search and its seed pilot. No candidate, winner, column, group, or weight is passed to solve. All work offline. Retain a complete deployable incumbent throughout.
resources: Discover compatible local sentence-transformer Transformer/Pooling packages by their declared topology and content. Also recognize supported pinned legacy standalone encoder layouts. Add a training-only co-occurrence embedding. Give the same categorical classifier and original columns to each representation. Unseen levels at inference retain their original category and use the training centroid in the added geometry. The delivered numeric dictionary is self-contained.
election: Screen singles, equal pairs of encoders and incumbent shares 0, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2, 1 for the challenger on the primary training partition. Rank by declared metric, then squared probability error, then fewer components. Lock one recipe, including its weight, before confirming. Compare the actual incumbent recipe including its deployed seeds on two disjoint confirmation partitions. Adopt only with positive gains on both and pooled metric gain >=0.003, with no increase in pooled multiclass Brier. Otherwise reuse the exact incumbent file. Both the review and full refits must fit the original 64-fit limit.
outer: Two ordinary previously studied outer panels (0,2) and two disjoint-profile previously studied panels (0,3) from the training archive. Use the audited independent 64-fit ordinary control on the same anonymous training/query packets. Require one complete new solve from raw inputs. Other runs may resume exactly at the frozen post-delivery boundary with all original fits debited. Seal all four predictions and independent process reloads before opening outer answers. Report denominators, changed rows and per-regime scores; never pool the two regimes since rows can overlap.
advance: Advance to a new independent training-only partition only if both outer regimes gain at least 0.003 pooled and neither has a losing panel. Otherwise keep 1561/2030 as the earlier course validation reference; leave course validation, formal test and H2 sealed in this stage.
